L7: # Free Remote MCP Servers
L8: 
L9: 11,903 public MCP server URLs answered without a key in our test. Pick one, paste it into Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code, done.
L10: 
L11: 11,903 of 20,778 remote MCP servers in the official MCP Registry (57 %) answered without any API key, token or login when we tested them on 2026-10-26. After removing copies and mass-generated entries, 9,631 remain. Below are 300 picks by topic; the full list is a free download.
L12: 【16†Download all 9,631 as CSV】 【17†JSON】 【18†GitHub (re-tested weekly)†github.com】
L13: ## How we tested
L14: 
L15: The 【19†official MCP Registry†registry.modelcontextprotocol.io】 listed 33,658 remote endpoints. We kept Streamable HTTP endpoints that require no headers, skipped temporary tunnels and tested at most five URLs per host, which left 20,778. Each got exactly two requests without credentials, `initialize` and `tools/list`; no tool was ever called. 11,903 answered with a tool list, 6,529 asked for authentication (OAuth or a key) and 2,346 did not answer correctly within 10 seconds.
L16: Many open servers are copies of the same template on hundreds of subdomains. We dropped entries whose tool set appears more than three times or whose description appears more than twice, and kept at most two per domain. The picks below prefer servers with a website or repository, 3 to 40 tools and fast responses, one per publisher. Open means usable without signing up, not free forever, and listing is not an endorsement: read what a server does before you connect it, especially if it can write or spend.
L17: ## Add a server
L18: 
L19: Claude: Customize, Connectors, + Add, Add custom connector, paste the URL. Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http NAME URL`. Cursor: `{ "mcpServers": { "NAME": { "url": "URL" } } }`. VS Code: `{ "servers": { "NAME": { "type": "http", "url": "URL" } } }`. Not sure a server still works? Use 【20†our MCP Server Tester】, every row has a «test it» link.
